scenes.tts: You need a clear plastic jar with a tight lid, about one to one and a half cups of bagged topsoil or garden soil, water, and masking tape.

items.text: 1 to 1½ cups bagged topsoil or garden soil

scenes.narration: You need a clear plastic jar with a tight lid, about one to one and a half cups of bagged topsoil or garden soil, water, and masking tape.

scenes.tts: Fill the jar about one third full of soil. Add water to about one inch from the top. You screw the lid on tight. Shake hard for two to three minutes, then set it down.
scenes.narration: Fill the jar about one third full of soil. Add water to about one inch from the top. You screw the lid on tight. Shake hard for two to three minutes, then set it down.

scenes.tts: Check at one minute, one hour, and one to two days. Sand usually settles first, then silt, then clay, and the water slowly clears.
scenes.narration: Check at one minute, one hour, and one to two days. Sand usually settles first, then silt, then clay, and the water slowly clears.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child while the soil and water are out. Use a plastic jar, never glass, and you tighten the lid before anyone shakes.
